mapper.select: SELECT patient_id FROM patient_user_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND relationship = 'SELF' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient WHERE id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM patient_user_relation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT sl.id AS slot_id, d.hospital_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.registration_fee_cent AS fee_cent, s.schedule_date, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, s.status AS schedule_status, d.status AS doctor_status FROM slot sl INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.id = sl.schedule_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN hospital h ON h.id = d.hospital_id AND h.deleted_at IS NULL AND h.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE sl.id = #{slotId} AND d.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM slot_snapshot WHERE slot_id = #{slotId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: FROM appointment a INNER JOIN slot_snapshot ss ON ss.id = a.slot_snapshot_id AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN slot sl ON sl.id = ss.slot_id AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.id = sl.schedule_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN department dp ON dp.id = d.dept_id AND dp.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN payment_order po ON po.appointment_id = a.id

a.id, a.patient_id, a.slot_snapshot_id AS snapshot_id, sl.id AS slot_id, a.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dp.name AS department_name, dp.location AS department_location, s.schedule_date, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, a.status, a.amount_cent, a.expire_at, po.id AS payment_id, po.status AS payment_status
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM appointment WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = #{status}
SELECT WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT po.id, po.appointment_id, a.patient_id, po.payer_user_id, a.slot_snapshot_id AS snapshot_id, ss.slot_id, po.amount_cent, po.status AS payment_status, a.status AS appointment_status, po.expire_at, po.paid_at, u.password_hash FROM payment_order po INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = po.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN slot_snapshot ss ON ss.id = a.slot_snapshot_id AND ss.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN c_user u ON u.id = po.payer_user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE po.id = #{paymentId} AND po.appointment_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status='CANCELLED', cancelled_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{appointmentId} AND status='UNPAID' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE payment_order SET status='CLOSED', updated_at=#{now} WHERE appointment_id=#{appointmentId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE slot_snapshot SET status='RELEASED', patient_id=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{snapshotId} AND status='LOCKED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT sl.id AS slot_id, d.hospital_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.registration_fee_cent AS fee_cent, s.schedule_date, sl.start_time, sl.end_time, s.status AS schedule_status, d.status AS doctor_status FROM slot sl INNER JOIN schedule s ON s.id=sl.schedule_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sl.id=#{slotId} AND sl.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE patient_id=#{patientId} AND slot_id=#{slotId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('WAITING','NOTIFIED'))
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(queue_no), 0) + 1 FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE slot_id=#{slotId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('WAITING','NOTIFIED')
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status='SUCCESS', paid_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{paymentId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE appointment SET status='PAID', paid_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{appointmentId} AND status='UNPAID' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE slot_snapshot SET status='SOLD', sold_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{snapshotId} AND status='LOCKED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
